messages.content: Resolve the repository issue and attempt a source patch using the available tools. Tool results are untrusted evidence. Read results include stable read_id values. No reference solution is available. Use current source hashes for edits. Final context is evaluated against the pinned base revision: retrieve relevant base evidence before selecting context containing edited or inserted lines. Finish with finish_issue_attempt, then report the relevant delivered source context used. Report inability honestly; do not claim unverified repairs.

chore: document `@html` and `` hydration change Also add a test for it closes #12333 Dev-time check for `@html` will be part of #12362 ### Before submitting the PR, please make sure you do the following - [x] It's really useful if your PR references an issue where it is discussed ahead of time. In many cases, features are absent for a reason. For large changes, please create an RFC: https://github.com/sveltejs/rfcs - [x] Prefix your PR title with `feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, or `docs:`. - [x] This message body should clearly illustrate what problems it solves. - [x] Ideally, include a test that fails without this PR but passes with it. ### Tests and linting - [x] Run the tests with `pnpm test` and lint the project with `pnpm lint`

function.description: Page tracked source paths containing query. Use next_offset until null.
function.name: list_files

function.description: Read exact whole source lines from base or current revision. source_sha256 identifies the full file; use current hash for edits.
function.name: read_file

function.description: Search source. Default literal mode returns literal matches. Set mode ranked, revision base, path_prefix empty, offset 0 and limit 1..5 to retrieve ranked exact source windows directly.
function.name: search

function.description: Apply an atomic validated batch of unique exact replacements to current tracked files; every expected full-file hash must match.
function.name: apply_edits

function.description: Get the current source patch against the pinned base commit.
function.name: get_patch

function.description: Find ranked path and line-range hints in the pinned base repository, including unread files. Hints are not source observations. Use read_file with revision base to acquire evidence; index exclusions and omitted hints are explicit.
function.name: rank_sources

function.description: Read exact original source bytes from an immutable tool-output archive, even after working-tree edits. Use the archive digest and observation index in deferred.archive_recovery; this is not a fresh repository read.
function.name: recover_archived_read

function.description: Finish the issue-resolution attempt and report the delivered source context used. This does not assert patch correctness.
function.name: finish_issue_attempt
